title: Cobblemon Reign
description: Cobblemon Server with Battle factory, Mega evolution, Gyms, Wonder Trade system, and much more!
body:
# ✨ COBBLEMON REIGN ✨
Cobblemon Reign is the best Cobblemon experience! We have tons of custom content, frequent updates ! Whether you're a competitive or casual player, there's a ton of stuff to do, there's something for everyone!

🌐 Server IP: play.cobblemonreign.com

💬 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/R7medU36Me

# 🌌 Custom Dimension
Expolore Area Zero and find all paradox, Koraidon, Miraidon and fight Kieran to obtain Terapagos

![idk](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a274f6bf4b4a5b00095519492b9eeb9345a41c9a.png)

# 🥇 COMPETITIVE GAMEPLAY
Take on real player Elite 4, NPC custome gyms, and queue Ranked battles. We have tons of mechanics to help with team building !

![idk](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1764aac9459a6370714e44599832771990a12d11.png)

# 🌍 WORLD GENERATION
Explore world with generation and structures mods, with custome loot chest !

![idk](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93a75db236f50bd7d2fcad75c99f7f5501142cc2.png)
